rows.q: What is our replenishment policy for high-risk inventory?
rows.message: This is a SAMPLE policy written for the DSports AI proof of concept. The planning target is a 95% cycle service level. Safety stock covers demand uncertainty over the supplier lead time. The reorder point is the forecast demand over the lead time plus the safety stock. Stock is reviewed weekly (a 7 day review period). The recommended quantity brings the inventory position up to the forecast demand over the lead time and review period plus the safety stock. Quantities are rounded up to the supplier's case pack and raised to the minimum order quantity.

rows.q: What is the minimum order quantity for our suppliers?
rows.message: This is a SAMPLE document written for the DSports AI proof of concept. For products priced below ₹5,000, the Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) is 6, 12, 24, or 48 units, and they ship in case packs of 6. For bats, bicycles, and premium shoes, the MOQ is 2, 4, or 6 units, with no case pack. The exact MOQ, case pack, and lead time for each SKU are in the inventory master data. A purchase order quantity is always rounded up to the MOQ and then to a whole number of case packs. This information is from the "Supplier Lead Times and MOQ" document.

rows.q: What is the clearance policy for inventory older than 90 days?
rows.message:
This is a SAMPLE policy written for the DSports AI proof of concept; it is not DSports' real pricing policy.
Inventory older than 90 days is reviewed for clearance every month. Inventory with more than 120 days of cover is classed as slow moving; with at least 180 days of cover it is high overstock. Stock older than 120 days that also has at least 150 days of cover is critical aging and is reviewed first. A clearance discount of up to 50% can be proposed by the merchandising team without further approval. A discount above 50% needs approval from the Head of Merchandising and the Finance controller. No promotion may leave a unit margin below 10% of the discounted selling price. Standard clearance promotions run for 14 days and are reviewed before they are extended. Do not start a clearance on a sport while one of its major events is in its demand window; stock is held for the event. The AI assistant never changes a price and never launches a promotion.
